'''Rebekah Gruver''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[February 2001 Buford tournament]] on 3 February 2001 with [[Agents In The Court / No Love For The Empire|AITC with Chadra Fans]], according to Adam Drake's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1706">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-06-galactic-quest-buford-ga-2-3-01d1706/ galactic-quest-buford-ga-2-3-01], DeckTech (Adam "ADrake" Drake, 6 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-06-galactic-quest-buford-ga-2-3-01d1706/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
